source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each artifact role view (kit, build, stages, Eternal, lane augment, matchup verdicts, honesty notes) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped

support.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to vine everyone nearby, keeping Thorns up for your carry. Once the tank items land, stand in front longer and drop Queen's Garden where they dive.
support.watchout: Into Riktor, Dekker or Muriel, wait for their hook or stun first, then Imperial Lash, since a hit dashes you onto them.

offlane.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to latch vines while you trade. Once Alternator and Mutilator land, chain fights back to back and drop Queen's Garden where they try to walk out.
offlane.watchout: Every lane matchup listed favors them; against Steel or Grux, skip the early lash, farm under tower and fight only with your jungler.

jungle.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root the target and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize them and Iron Rose to take less damage while you hit. Once Mutilator joins Alternator around minute 16, save Queen's Garden for when they try to run.
jungle.watchout: Against a Kaelen or Khaimera who wins the trade up close, stop forcing duels in their jungle and gank lanes with your team instead.

offlane.line: Open with Web Lash to root, step in so Crushing Maw hits point-blank for the bonus damage and heal, then Hellfire behind them to slow the retreat. Once the magic items stack, use Consume to pull them back into you when they walk out.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup listed favors them; against Steel or Greystone, farm safely under tower and wait for your jungler before trading.

jungle.line: Gank from fog with Web Lash to root, then Crushing Maw up close and Hellfire behind them to slow the escape. As the magic items come online, save Consume for clumped enemies and pull them into your bite.
jungle.watchout: Kaelen, Khaimera, Serath and Kwang all beat you here; avoid their jungle and only invade with your laners close.

support.line: Root their carry with Web Lash, then step in close for a harder Crushing Maw while Hellfire slows anyone running. Once Stonewall and Forticus are done, stand in front and use Consume to drag enemies into your bite.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our sim, so let them use their engage first, then answer with Web Lash.

midlane.line: Land Dread Nova first for the stun, then hold Particle Shredder on them so Disintegrate stacks grow with every hit. Once the magic items are in, Synaptic Obliterator from safe range finishes stacked targets, and Ether Crystal pushes divers off you.
midlane.watchout: Every mid matchup listed favors them; if Renna or Gideon start chunking you, play back, farm safely and wait for a gank.

support.line: Poke with Dread Nova to stun, then Particle Shredder while they are stuck, and use Ether Crystal to push divers off your carry. Once Stonewall lands, hold the front longer and channel Synaptic Obliterator on low targets for the missing-health damage.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker, a hook or stun cancels your plan; save Ether Crystal to peel and fire your ultimate only after they commit.

offlane.line: Stand behind your minions and poke with Dread Nova, then drop Ether Crystal on anyone who dives you to slow them and pull them into its center. Once Inquisition and Timewarp are done, follow a Dread Nova stun with Synaptic Obliterator beams on the lowest-health target.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Grux, Aurora and Crunch all win this lane on our sim, so farm from range and only trade when your jungler arrives.

offlane.line: Dash in with Glacial Charge, drop Hoarfrost on top of them for the root, then Boreal Sweep for the slow and delayed burst. Once your magic items land, open fights with Cryoseism and follow with Hoarfrost so the stun chains into a root.
offlane.watchout: Steel and Greystone win this lane; if Hoarfrost misses, jump away to leave your Replica behind and reset instead of trading again.

jungle.line: Gank with Glacial Charge, land Hoarfrost on the laner, then Boreal Sweep while they are rooted. Later, Cryoseism a grouped fight and jump to reposition, leaving your Replica behind.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you here; if he contests your camps, give the camp, then hit his laners instead of dueling him.

support.line: Engage with Glacial Charge to cut off their escape, then Hoarfrost to root and Boreal Sweep to slow while your carry hits. Once Inquisition and Raiment of Renewal land, go in first and land Cryoseism on clumped enemies so the stun sets up kills.
support.watchout: Against Dekker the lane is even; do not charge in alone, let her use her stun first, then engage.

offlane.line: Leap in with Skull Crusher to mark and shred armor, pop Dire Howl for the slow and power buff, then chain Cursed Edge slashes through them. Once your damage items are in, finish runners with Kingslayer and keep swinging through Berserk at low health.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup listed favors them; against Steel or Grux, trade only with Skull Crusher ready and farm under tower otherwise.

jungle.line: Gank with Skull Crusher onto the laner, Dire Howl to slow, then Cursed Edge while they try to walk out. Once the damage items land, look for Kingslayer on isolated carries and dive knowing Berserk keeps you swinging.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath and Kwang win this setup; don't contest their camps early, take objectives on the opposite side instead.

support.line: Open with Skull Crusher on the enemy carry, then land all three Cursed Edge slashes for the stun and pop Dire Howl to slow and heal. Once Stonewall and Forticus are done, stand in front longer and save Kingslayer for whoever dives your carry.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Mourn, leaping in first just feeds their pull; hold Skull Crusher until they have used it, then go.

jungle.line: Mark a target with Detection Protocol and ride the scent trail into the gank, Chrono Swipe through them, then Primeval Roar to soak their reply and explode it. Once the magic items land, grab their carry with Ursine Burst and slam them into your team.
jungle.watchout: All four jungle matchups listed favor them; skip early duels, guard your camps, and gank lanes that have a stun or slow ready.

offlane.line: Mark your target with Detection Protocol to run them down, open with Chrono Swipe, then slam them with Ursine Burst and let Primeval Roar scare them as they flee. Once Noxia and Crescelia land, stay in longer and keep swinging to fill Canisters.
offlane.watchout: Into Steel, Grux or Crunch your all-in loses the trade; farm safely near your tower and only commit when your jungler arrives.

midlane.line: Open with Eventide from range, then Shadow Slip in so the second hit applies Haemorrhage, and spin Blade Siphon to heal off them. Once your magic items land, Feast the target already bleeding and re-trigger Shadow Slip to swap back out.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget beat you here; while their big spells are up, poke with Eventide and hold Shadow Slip until they spend them.

offlane.line: Trade with Eventide, then Shadow Slip onto them and Blade Siphon for the heal, ending each trade by swapping back to your Shadow. Once your magic items land, hold Feast for whoever is already bleeding from Haemorrhage.
offlane.watchout: Greystone and Zarus beat you here; if Shadow Slip is on cooldown, don't step in, farm with Eventide until it's back.

jungle.line: Gank with Shadow Slip from fog, Eventide as they turn, Blade Siphon to heal, then swap back out if the lane answers. Once your magic items land, Feast the carry that is already bleeding and keep cycling abilities to reapply Haemorrhage.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you here; when he's near your camps, clear the other side and never fight him without your laners.

offlane.line: Dash in with Forward Crunch, then Left Crunch and Right Crunch, weaving a basic attack between each so Cross Crunch lowers your cooldowns. Once Turbo builds, empower Right Crunch for the knock-up and Re-Crunch it; damage items make every combo hurt more.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup listed favors them; if Steel or Greystone out-trade you, keep Forward Crunch to escape instead of opening with it.

jungle.line: Gank with Forward Crunch, Right Crunch to slow, then Left Crunch, with basic attacks between each so Cross Crunch keeps cooldowns rolling. Save the Turbo-empowered Right Crunch knock-up for the gank itself, then Re-Crunch it as your damage items come online.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you here; don't duel them in their jungle, play near your laners and take their camps when they show elsewhere.

support.line: Trap enemies with Containment Fence, then land Stasis Bomb from long range for the longer stun and sweep Photon Disruptor through them. Once the tankier items land, stand closer and save Ion Strike for whoever your fence just trapped.
support.watchout: Containment Fence only blocks enemy heroes, so place it between the divers and your carry to keep them off.

midlane.line: Open with Stasis Bomb from long range for a longer stun, then run Photon Disruptor through them and land Ion Strike on the stunned target. Once Orion and Noxia are done, trap them in Containment Fence first so your burst cannot be walked out of.
midlane.watchout: If Gideon or Gadget wins the poke war, stop trading back; hold Stasis Bomb and Containment Fence for when they step up.

offlane.line: Bounce Stasis Bomb from range to stun your lane opponent, then follow with Photon Disruptor and Ion Strike while they cannot move. Once Orion and Noxia land, use Containment Fence to cut off their escape and Rocket Boots to speed your team in.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, a fighter who walks through your poke, do not stand and trade; fence him off, back away, and poke from range.

carry.line: Throw Old Rusty to slow, pop Rad Rounds and keep shooting so the boomerang's return detonates Irradiate, then Gag Grenade anyone diving you. Once the crit items land, fire Shrapnel Cannon in the air to shred armor and bounce away.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, Murdock and Kira beat you here; farm safely until your crit items are in instead of trading every wave.

midlane.line: Silence them with Gag Grenade, turn on Rad Rounds and shoot, then throw Old Rusty to make the stacks erupt at once. Once Viper and Manta Scythe are done, push the wave and save Shrapnel Cannon to lower their armor when your team commits.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Gadget win this lane on our sim; farm from max range and only trade after they waste their big ability.

offlane.line: Turn on Rad Rounds and shoot to stack Irradiate, then throw Old Rusty through them to make every stack erupt at once. Once Viper and Manta Scythe are done, open fights with Gag Grenade to silence and finish with Shrapnel Cannon.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Grux, Aurora and Crunch win this lane on our sim; when they dive, jump and fire Shrapnel Cannon to blast yourself away.

carry.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and the Sidewind Railshot, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive in once they're low. When Helios Core overheats and your items are in, Limit Break finishes the fight.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, Murdock and Kira beat you here; stay ranged and farm, and only shift to melee after they've burned their escape.

offlane.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and the Sidewind Railshot, then Zero Shift into melee and dash in with Talon Drive when they are low. Once Sky Splitter and Viper land, keep attacking to build Heat and fire Limit Break the moment you Overheat.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone and Grux all favor them; stay ranged, poke from safety and only switch to melee when your jungler arrives.

midlane.line: Trade from ranged stance with Tachyon Lance through the wave, then Zero Shift and dash in with Talon Drive when they slip up. Once Sky Splitter, Viper and Deathstalker land, keep firing to build Heat and cash in Limit Break when you Overheat.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Renna and Gideon all favor them here; stay out of their range, clear the wave and roam instead of forcing trades.

jungle.line: Gank with Reaping Dash, swing Hamstring on a lone target for the bonus damage, and hold Safeguard to block their answer. Once takedowns build Executioners Path and your damage items land, Earth Shatter low targets to execute them.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath and Kwang beat you here; skip early duels and build takedowns from ganks before contesting their jungle.

offlane.line: Trade by Reaping Dash in, Hamstring them while they're alone for the bonus damage, then Safeguard as they reply to block their key ability. Once your damage items land, Earth Shatter the moment they drop low for the execute.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup listed favors them; against Grux or Steel, farm under tower and save Safeguard for their engage.

midlane.line: Stick a Sticky Mine on them, then send Seek and Destroy and stop it above them so it follows as they walk off. Once the magic items land, drop Tesla Dome on grouped fights and use Security Gate to speed your team in or out.
midlane.watchout: Gideon beats you here; when he jumps on you, run through Security Gate instead of trading back.

support.line: Stick a Sticky Mine on their carry and basic attack it for the bigger blast, then throw Security Gate to root them as they walk in. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall land, stand in front and drop Tesla Dome on their team.
support.watchout: If you waste Security Gate on poke, you have no root when they dive; hold it until someone walks at your carry.

offlane.line: Release Seek and Destroy over the enemy laner, then land Sticky Mine and basic attack it for the empowered blast, using Security Gate to root them. Once Orion lands, trade every time your mines are up and drop Tesla Dome to finish.
offlane.watchout: Every listed matchup favors you, but a missed Security Gate leaves you open to a dive; stay behind your wave until it is up.

midlane.line: Land Void Breach to slow, drop Cosmic Rift on the slowed target, then basic attack to tether them with Cosmic Power. Once your magic items land, Torn Space into the middle of fights and Black Hole while your team holds them there.
midlane.watchout: Black Hole leaves you a sitting target while you channel; if their divers are alive, cast it from fog or wait for your frontline.

offlane.line: Slow them with Void Breach, then basic attack to tether them and drop Cosmic Rift as the tether roots them. Once Combustion and Orion are done, jump in with Torn Space and drop Black Hole when enemies group up.
offlane.watchout: Don't channel Black Hole while their divers can still reach you; you're stuck for most of it, so wait for their engage first.

support.line: Slow their carry with Void Breach, then basic attack to tether and root them for your carry. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done, stand in front and when a fight turns, leap back with Torn Space so your carry can follow through the portal.
support.watchout: A Torn Space used to start fights leaves you no escape; against divers, keep it for getting yourself and your carry out.

offlane.line: Leap in with Assault The Gates, Make Way under them to shred armor, then the empowered Sacred Oath basic for the cleave. Hitting a hero with Assault The Gates cuts its cooldown by 30%, so you leap again sooner.
offlane.watchout: Steel beats you here; don't leap first into him, trade after he's used his engage and keep Stone Forged Soul ready.

jungle.line: Gank with Assault The Gates to leap in, then Make Way to shred armor and the Sacred Oath swing to slow their escape. Once Alternator and The Perforator land, take longer fights and drop Stone Forged Soul in the middle to heal and crash.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you here; avoid fighting him alone in his jungle and gank lanes where your laner can follow up.

midlane.line: Leap onto a hero with Assault The Gates for a shorter cooldown, then Make Way to lower their armor and Sacred Oath to slow. Once The Perforator and Manta Scythe are done, use Stone Forged Soul mid-fight to heal and crash down on them.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget win this lane on our sim; skip leaping in on them early and push the wave to roam instead.

carry.line: Poke with Displacement Blast and basic attacks so every hit pops Pulsefire, and raise Energy Shield just before their key ability lands. Once your items are in, switch to Assault Mode for long-range cleave and fire GTFO at low carries running away.
carry.watchout: Assault Mode drains mana fast; if you run dry mid-fight, switch back to Sentry Mode to refill before you re-engage.

midlane.line: Refill mana in Sentry Mode, then flip to Assault Mode to poke from long range and lob Displacement Blast to knock divers away. Once Prophecy and Spectra are done, hold Energy Shield for their key ability and finish runners with GTFO.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget win this lane on our sim; play from max range and keep Energy Shield ready for their opener before you trade.

offlane.line: Open with Displacement Blast, burst the Pulsefire mark with a basic attack, and raise Energy Shield as they throw an ability. Once Orion and Prophecy are done, switch to Assault Mode to hit from long range and save GTFO for a fleeing target.
offlane.watchout: When a tanky enemy runs at you, Assault Mode drains your mana fast; flip back to Sentry Mode and walk away before you run dry.

offlane.line: Pull them in with Smash 'n Grab, cleave with Double Pain to stack Bloodlust bleeds, and Stampede after them when they run. Once the damage items land, open with Warlord's Challenge to stun and keep swinging through the long fight.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Aurora and Zarus beat you here; if Smash 'n Grab misses, back off instead of chasing into their trades.

jungle.line: Gank with Stampede to drag them toward your laner, then Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, and keep basic attacking to stack Bloodlust. Once Alternator and Viper land, open fights with Warlord's Challenge and stay on one target to extend it.
jungle.watchout: Kwang favors them; do not chase him alone through his jungle, gank lanes instead where your laner adds damage.

support.line: Charge in with Stampede to drag the enemy carry, then use Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun anyone who escapes, and cleave with Double Pain to heal back. Once Inquisition and Stonewall are done, open fights with Warlord's Challenge and stay on your target.
support.watchout: If Riktor or Dekker stops your Stampede early, you are stuck alone in front of them; wait for their stun to be used before charging.

midlane.line: Layer H11 Cluster Grenades where they walk, Land Mine to knock them into the grenades, then R2000 Missile while they're slowed. Once your magic items land, Make It Rain over grouped fights from a safe angle.
midlane.watchout: Gadget beats you here; R2000 Missile holds you in the air, so only fire it after Gadget has used his abilities.

offlane.line: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades where they walk, then lob Land Mine to stun and knock them back and land R2000 Missile while they're slowed. Once Combustion and Orion are done, step forward and use Make It Rain while your grenades slow them.
offlane.watchout: Land Mine knocks you back too, so when a fighter dives you, drop it between you and them, then pop it early to blast clear.

support.line: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades and a Land Mine where enemies will walk, then charge R2000 Missile at whoever is slowed or stunned. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done, stand closer to your carry and save Land Mine to knock divers away.
support.watchout: When a diver reaches you during the R2000 Missile hover, you are a sitting target; drop Land Mine at your feet and blast yourself out.

midlane.line: Place Flame Turret by the wave, roll Oil Spill through them, then ignite it with Molotov for the burn. Once your magic items land, fight next to your turrets and Inferno into the oil while they fire faster.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget beat you here; if they keep breaking your turrets, play behind the wave and only fight once they're spent.

offlane.line: Drop Flame Turret near the wave, then roll Oil Spill and ignite it with Molotov so the fire burns while they stand in it. Once Combustion and Orion land, hit them with Spew to point every turret at them and finish with Inferno.
offlane.watchout: Greystone favors them; his leap reaches you over the oil, so keep turrets between you and him and back off before he commits.

support.line: Drop Flame Turret near the fight, hit the target with Spew so the turrets lock on, then throw Molotov onto Oil Spill to set the oil burning. Once Stonewall and Forticus are built, stand closer and hold the area instead of backing off.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane, so place turrets where you will actually fight and hold Inferno until she commits.

carry.line: Drop a Hydroclasm bubble near them, pop it with Brine for the area damage, then Narcosis whoever tries to walk out. Once your magic items land, Genesis through walls to finish fleeing targets.
carry.watchout: Murdock is an even lane; don't throw Narcosis first, because missing it leaves you nothing to stop his trade.

midlane.line: Poke with Brine, set a Hydroclasm bubble in the lane and pop it when they step in, then Narcosis to lock them for your jungler. Once your magic items land, Genesis through walls to end fights or catch rotations.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget beat you here; if they chunk you first, farm by popping bubbles on the wave and wait for help.

support.line: Land Narcosis to suspend a target, then drop Hydroclasm on them and pop the amplified bubble with Brine for the big hit. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall land, stand at the front and aim Genesis through walls when they clump.
support.watchout: Dekker favors them; once Narcosis is spent you have no peel, so hold it for her engage instead of using it to poke.

jungle.line: Open with Rimefang to slow and lay Rimeglass, then Winter's Pursuit onto the frostbitten target for double damage and a root, and Razorstorm on the ice. Once your items land, Frostfall into the fight to cleanse and leave a Rimestorm behind.
jungle.watchout: Winter's Pursuit only roots frostbitten targets; if Rimefang misses, don't lunge in, wait for it to come back.

offlane.line: Open with Rimefang to slow and lay Rimeglass, then Winter's Pursuit onto a Frostbitten target for the root, and spin Razorstorm while they stand on ice. Once Alternator and Viper land, chase longer with basic attacks and save Frostfall to cleanse and finish.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone and Grux all favor them; trade only when they stand on your Rimeglass, otherwise farm and wait for your jungler.

support.line: Throw Rimefang to slow and lay Rimeglass, then Winter's Pursuit onto a Frostbitten target to root them for your carry. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall land, stand in front, spin Razorstorm on the ice for extra armor and save Frostfall to cleanse.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker favor them; do not lunge in first, let them use their hook or stun, then root whoever is left.

jungle.line: Hit with Crippling Dagger to apply Death Mark, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target for double damage before it detonates. Once your damage items land, Shadow Walk to flank their carry and finish low targets with Guillotine.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you here; Shadow Walk past their jungle instead of dueling, and only commit when the carry is alone.

jungle.line: Leap in with Ambush on a damaged target, Unleash for a burst of fast cleaving attacks, then Cull to stun everyone in front. Once your damage items land, save Invigorate to cleanse the stun or slow that would let them escape you.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you here; if he's near, take a different camp and keep Invigorate up before any fight with him.

offlane.line: Jump in with Ambush when they are low, then Unleash for fast attacks and save Invigorate to cleanse their stun. Once Resolution and The Perforator land, stay in fights to keep Rage up and finish with Cull on a clump.
offlane.watchout: Greystone and Grux favor them; do not Ambush first, wait for their engage, Invigorate out of it, then hit back.

midlane.line: Jump on a hurt target with Ambush, hit Unleash for a burst of fast swings, and save Invigorate to shake off their slows and stuns. Once Resolution and The Perforator land, finish fights with Cull when several enemies stand in front of you.
midlane.watchout: Into Gadget or Iggy & Scorch they wear you down from range before you land; dive only after they spend their abilities on the wave.

carry.line: Shoot Mercy and basic attacks to stack Vengeance, then cast Dusk to cash out the stacks and slow. Shadow Glide to dodge or reposition; once crit items land, Purge up close and Glide out after a takedown resets it.
carry.watchout: Murdock beats you here; don't Shadow Glide forward to trade, keep it for escape until your crit items are in.

midlane.line: Poke with Mercy and basic attacks to stack Vengeance, then cash it in with Dusk and use Shadow Glide to dodge their answer. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, stay at range and keep hitting, saving Purge for when enemies are grouped and slowed.
midlane.watchout: Against Lt. Belica, Gideon or Gadget, trading in their spell range loses; stay back, poke with Mercy, and hold Shadow Glide to escape.

offlane.line: Land Mercy to stack Vengeance, add basic attacks, then cast Dusk to pop the stacks and slow them, keeping Shadow Glide to escape. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done around minute 16, trade with long basic-attack chains and use Purge when they commit.
offlane.watchout: When Steel or Greystone dives you, Shadow Glide out and reset; Purge slows you, so save it until their engage is spent.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, cast Light of the Heavens while the blade is still out for true damage, then Surge of the Heavens back to it for the knock-up. Later, Fury of the Heavens teleports to your blade, so throw it behind their carry first.
jungle.watchout: Recalling the blade early breaks the tether; if Judgement of the Heavens misses, hold Surge of the Heavens to escape instead.

offlane.line: Trade by throwing Judgement of the Heavens, then Surge of the Heavens to recall it and knock them up, and Light of the Heavens while shielded. Once your items land, use Fury of the Heavens to teleport into a fight from your thrown blade.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup listed favors you, so ganks are the danger; with your dash used, back off when their jungler is missing.

support.line: Tether a target with Judgement of the Heavens, Surge of the Heavens to the blade to knock up, then shield with Light of the Heavens. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal land, hold the front and slow their dive with Fury of the Heavens.
support.watchout: Dekker favors them; a missed blade leaves you with no follow-up, so throw it only after she has used her stun.

carry.line: Plant Rally Point for infinite ammo and team healing, shoot from inside it, and lob Saturation Charge to slow divers. Once your damage items land, a cooked Frag Order finishes low targets and Orbital Sanction zones them out of fights.
carry.watchout: Every carry matchup listed favors them; play behind your support, farm safely, and never cook Frag Order inside their range.

midlane.line: Throw Saturation Charge to slow them, then Frag Order to burst, and keep the K-75 Storm Rifle firing between casts. Once Sky Splitter and Spectra land, plant Rally Point in fights for infinite ammo and lob Orbital Sanction where they cannot walk out.
midlane.watchout: Every listed midlane matchup favors them; push the wave from max range and back off whenever you have to reload.

offlane.line: Slow them with Saturation Charge, follow with Frag Order, and keep firing the K-75 Storm Rifle while they are slowed. Once Sky Splitter and Spectra land, plant Rally Point for infinite ammo and the knock back, then lob Orbital Sanction on whoever stays.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone and Grux all favor them; when they dive, use Rally Point to knock them back and walk away rather than trade.

midlane.line: Drop Void Drone near them to drain mana, Seismic Assault to stun, then Void Bomb on the stunned spot. Once your magic items land, Neural Disruptor hits harder on targets missing mana, so drain first and finish with it.
midlane.watchout: Gideon, Gadget and Iggy & Scorch beat you here; if they shove you under tower, save Seismic Assault for the gank, not wave clear.

support.line: Drop Void Drone where the enemy duo stands, land Seismic Assault, then put Void Bomb on the stunned target so the drone zaps them. Once Stonewall lands, stand in front and save Neural Disruptor for whoever just burned their mana.
support.watchout: Dekker is the matchup marked theirs; play behind your carry and hold Seismic Assault until they commit.

carry.line: Drop Void Drone on the enemy to drain their mana, land Seismic Assault for the stun, then finish with Neural Disruptor while their mana is low. As Combustion and Wraith Leggings come online, take short fights and cycle Void Bomb and Seismic Assault.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our sim, so stay behind minions and only commit when Seismic Assault can land the stun.

support.line: Throw Maco Sparkle! from long range so the stun lasts longer, then leap in with Maco Fly! for the slow and shield and lob Maco Gift! onto your carry. Once Lifecore and Noxia are done, stay beside your carry and heal through fights.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Mourn beat you in lane; against them, stop leaping in first and keep Maco Fly! to escape.

midlane.line: Mark the target, throw Hive to slow them, then run through them with Swarm to stack Pestilence before casting Curse. After Orion and Timewarp, repeat that loop in every short fight, refreshing Swarm by passing through heroes.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; if they outrange you, farm with Hive and keep Swarm for escaping.

offlane.line: Mark your target, then throw Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, keeping Fetid Dagger hits on them to refresh it. Once Orion and Timewarp land, use Swarm to run through them and heal, then cast Curse on the Marked target to finish.
offlane.watchout: Greystone favors them; save Swarm to escape his leap instead of engaging with it, and trade only from range.

support.line: Open with Mark on the enemy carry, slow them with Hive, then pass through them with Swarm to heal and refresh it. Finish with Curse while the Mark holds; once Lifecore and Noxia are done, stay beside your carry and save Swarm to escape danger.
support.watchout: Against Dekker, diving in with Swarm can get you stunned and fenced in; hold Swarm to get out and poke with Hive instead.

support.line: Wind up Abduct to pull an enemy in, then charge Beguile to mesmerize them and spit Contagion over your carry for healing and armor. Once Lifecore and Noxia land, cast Eclipse to blind the enemy team right before your side starts a fight.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat you in lane; if Abduct misses, back off instead of walking in slowed by your own channel.

offlane.line: Wind up Abduct to pull them in, then Beguile to mesmerize and Contagion to cut their armor while you heal. Once Orion and Noxia land, chain your abilities back to back in fights and use Eclipse to blind them before a dive.
offlane.watchout: Every listed matchup favors them; against Steel or Grux, skip long Abduct trades, farm safely and fight with your jungler.

jungle.line: Hook a target with Abduct, then channel Beguile as they land to mesmerize them, and throw Contagion to soften their armor while you heal. Once Orion and Noxia are done, start ganks with Eclipse so the enemy loses vision before you pull.
jungle.watchout: When Khaimera, Serath or Kwang invade your camps, do not trade alone; back off, wait for your laners, and catch them with Abduct.

carry.line: Lay Static Trap where enemies will walk, Buckshot them up close to shred armor, then chain basic attacks under Hot Pursuit. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, stay back in fights and fire Long Arm of the Law at fleeing targets.
carry.watchout: If divers jump you, Buckshot them away and run with Hot Pursuit instead of standing still to trade.

offlane.line: Place Static Trap where they walk, then Buckshot them while rooted to shred armor, and keep basic attacking to fire the Shots Fired empowered shot. Once Deathstalker and Viper land, stack Hot Pursuit in fights and finish runners with Long Arm of the Law.
offlane.watchout: Steel and Greystone favor them; when they dive, Buckshot them away and step back instead of trading up close.

midlane.line: Place Static Trap where enemies will walk, then use Hot Pursuit and keep landing basic attacks to charge Shots Fired, using Buckshot up close to shred their armor. Once Deathstalker and Viper are built, stay in longer fights and win trades with basic attacks.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget win this lane, so keep traps between you and them and save Long Arm of the Law for fleeing targets.

support.line: Charge Serenity to full to stun, then drop Consecrated Ground under the fight and throw Alacrity to your carry as they take damage. Once Lifecore and Noxia land, save Reversal Of Fortune to fly in and shield a teammate in trouble.
support.watchout: Into Riktor or Dekker, a hook or stun catches you mid-charge; stand behind your carry and tap Serenity for the slow instead.

support.line: Keep Song Of My People on, land Thunk to stun the target, then shout March! so your carry can chase or escape. Once Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown land, walk into the middle of fights and channel Crash Bang Boom! to mesmerize anyone who stays.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker beat you in lane; against them, hold Thunk until they commit instead of walking forward first.

midlane.line: Throw Data Burst to slow, send L.I.N.X through the target and back, then dash with Erase Vector for the exploding Jolt. Three abilities make your next one Overclocked, so save it for Data Burst's mesmerize, and use Final Thread to finish low targets.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; farm safely when behind and only trade when your abilities are ready.

support.line: Throw Data Burst to slow a target, follow with L.I.N.X, and use Erase Vector to dash into a boosted Jolt; after three casts your next ability is powered up. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall are done around minute 17, stand in front and absorb hits.
support.watchout: When Riktor or Dekker lands their engage on you early, do not trade back before Stonewall; give ground and wait for your carry.

support.line: Link your carry with Telekinetic Link, channel Energy Lance on the target until it roots, then blast Psychic Flare to blind them. Once Warp Stream and Raiment of Renewal are done, stay linked and pop Hyperflux the moment your carry commits.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker beat you in lane; if they reach you, pull your carry back with Telekinetic Link instead of channeling.

midlane.line: Link a teammate with Telekinetic Link, open with Energy Lance to slow until the root lands, then Psychic Flare to blind them. Once Orion and Spirit Of Amir are done, fire Hyperflux as you and your linked ally commit together.
midlane.watchout: Into Lt. Belica or Gideon, their big damage beats your Energy Lance channel; stay near your linked ally and fight after they waste abilities.

jungle.line: Pick up Boulder Throw to stun the target, then Pounce in and Rumble to keep them slowed. Once Inquisition and Mutilator are done, open fights with Behemoth near several enemies for the bigger healing and instant boulder throws.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in lane; skip early jungle duels with them and gank lanes instead.

offlane.line: Carry Boulder Throw in, Pounce while holding it so the boulder shatters on landing and stuns them, then Rumble to slow them. Once Inquisition and Mutilator are built, use Behemoth in fights near several enemies to heal more while you keep swinging.
offlane.watchout: Every listed opponent, Steel and Grux included, wins this lane, so farm near your tower and only fight when your jungler arrives.

support.line: Open with Boulder Throw to stun the target, then Pounce in and Rumble to keep them slowed while your carry hits them. Once Inquisition and Stonewall land around minute 18, start fights first and pop Behemoth when several enemies are close for bigger healing.
support.watchout: If Riktor or Dekker lands their stun or pull on you first, stop forcing Pounce and hold Boulder Throw to stun whoever jumps your carry.

midlane.line: Mesmerize with Stupor, drop Mortal Coil on the target to pull and heal, then sweep Soulfire through them. Collect Essence after every kill since it powers all your abilities, and after Orion and Noxia use Abyssal Rift to jump into fights.
midlane.watchout: Most matchups here read theirs; if you fall behind, stop forcing trades and farm safely until your items arrive.

support.line: Land Stupor to mesmerize a target, then drop Mortal Coil on them and sweep Soulfire through the pull while your carry follows up. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall land, stand in front to soak hits, and walk over Essence after fights to power up every ability.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker beat you in lane; if they catch you before Stupor lands, back off and wait for it to come back.

offlane.line: Open with Stupor to mesmerize, land Mortal Coil on them to pull and heal yourself, then fire Soulfire while they are stuck. Once Orion and Noxia are done, grab Essence from every kill and use Abyssal Rift to join longer fights.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Grux and Zarus all win this lane up close; when they walk at you, back off and hit them from range with Soulfire instead.

carry.line: Hit the target with Scar, fire Obliterate so the missiles home in and trigger the root, then finish with basic attacks and Hellfire Rounds reloads. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to drag a lone target away from their team.
carry.watchout: Nearly every lane matchup reads theirs; when losing trades, farm safely and save Reckoning for picks, not lane duels.

midlane.line: Open with Scar to mark the target, fire Obliterate so the missiles home onto them, and make the last shot before each reload count, since Fate's final round always crits. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, trade longer on basic attacks and save Reckoning for a duel you can win.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Renna, Valmont, Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; farm safely from range and wait for jungle help.

offlane.line: Throw Scar first, then shoot the marked target with basic attacks until the root lands and finish with Obliterate. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker land around minute 16, use Reckoning to isolate a weakened enemy and make every final shot count.
offlane.watchout: Against Grux or Crunch, never use Reckoning on a healthy fighter alone; trade from range and reload with Hellfire Rounds before going back in.

support.line: Hook a target with Riplash, silence them with Shock Therapy, and turn on Electrocute as you close in. Once Stonewall and Forticus are done, walk to the front and Skewer several enemies at once to start fights.
support.watchout: Dekker is the one matchup marked theirs; if Riplash misses, back off instead of walking in without your pull.

offlane.line: Hook with Riplash, follow with Shock Therapy to silence and strip shields, then switch on Electrocute while you trade up close. Once Orion and Prophecy are done, hold Skewer until two enemies stand in front of you and lock them down together.
offlane.watchout: If Riplash misses, back off until it is ready again instead of walking into a full-health laner without a pull.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Electrocute, then gank from fog: Riplash the laner into your team, Shock Therapy to silence them, and Skewer when the lane can follow. Once Orion and Prophecy are done, you can stay in fights longer instead of only setting up.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in the jungle; avoid contesting his camps alone and gank lanes where your Riplash has follow-up.

offlane.line: Dash in with First Intent for the shield, land the outer edge of Ashen Vow to empower Cindara, then finish with Minueta on a low target. Once Resolution and The Perforator are done, open with Swan Song and stay Ablaze through the fight.
offlane.watchout: Most offlane matchups read theirs; if you lose early trades, farm with Ashen Vow and wait for Swan Song before engaging.

jungle.line: Dash in with First Intent for the shield, swing Ashen Vow so outer edge hits empower Cindara, then finish low targets with Minueta. Once Resolution and The Perforator are done, open fights with Swan Song on a squishy target and stay Ablaze.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in the jungle; skip trades with them and take fights where your team can follow Swan Song.

support.line: Dash through the enemy duo with First Intent for the shield, then swing Ashen Vow so its outer edge slows them and charges your next Cindara. Once Warp Stream and Earthshaker land, lock their carry with Swan Song and stay beside your carry.
support.watchout: Into Riktor or Dekker a pull or trap catches you mid-dash; hold First Intent until they miss it, then go in.

jungle.line: Open with Ascend from range, Chastise to slow and reset your basic attack, then Heaven's Fury to chase. Once Alternator and Mutilator are done, chain takedowns: touching the visage triggers Heresy for free and cuts your cooldowns for the next fight.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in lane; skip early duels with them and fight only where a takedown is likely.

offlane.line: Open with Chastise to slow and reset your basic attack, weave basic attacks, then use Heaven's Fury to reach a fleeing target. Once Alternator and Mutilator are done, dive squishy backliners with Ascend and chain Heresy off takedowns.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora and Grux beat you in lane; farm under tower and look for Ascend ganks once your jungler arrives.

offlane.line: Drop Subjugate on the enemy, dash through with Phantom Rush to fear them, then Siphon to steal health. Last-hit with abilities to build Souls, and after Orion and Timewarp finish fights with Colossal Blow.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup here reads theirs; when losing trades, farm Souls near your tower with Siphon instead of forcing fights.

jungle.line: Gank by dashing in with Phantom Rush, drop Subjugate to chain the target, then Siphon to steal health. Clear camps with abilities to build Souls, and after Orion and Timewarp finish with Colossal Blow to knock them toward your team.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath and Kwang beat you in lane; avoid their jungle and gank lanes where Subjugate can land.

offlane.line: Dash in with Rushing Beat, send Line Tempo through the target, and use Circle Rhythm for the shield while you stack Track. Once Orion and Timewarp are done, fight only with All-Kill! ready so it hits every marked enemy.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup reads theirs; if they win early trades, farm with Line Tempo and keep Rushing Beat to escape.

jungle.line: Dash in with Rushing Beat, fire Line Tempo, then cast Circle Rhythm for the shield while ability hits stack Track. Once Orion and Timewarp are done, cycle abilities faster to reach max Track and finish fights by activating All-Kill! on every marked hero.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath and Kwang beat you in the jungle; avoid their camps and gank lanes instead of dueling them.

midlane.line: Open with Line Tempo, Rushing Beat through the target, then Circle Rhythm for the shield, marking them with every ability hit until All-Kill! is ready. Once Orion and Timewarp are built, repeat that combo in short fights and finish with All-Kill!.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget win this lane, so keep one Rushing Beat charge to escape instead of diving them alone.

carry.line: Stick Plasma Grenade on the target for the slow, then rise with Air Assault and turn on Hypercharge to shred them from above. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, save Atomiser for low-health targets trying to escape.
carry.watchout: TwinBlast, Sparrow, Murdock and Kira beat you in lane; if you lose trades, farm with Plasma Grenade and wait for items.

midlane.line: Poke with Plasma Grenade, then hover with Air Assault for extra range and turn on Hypercharge to shred the slowed target. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, stay on basic attacks through longer trades and save Atomiser to finish a low target.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Renna, Valmont, Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; give up farm before you give up a death, and wait for ganks.

offlane.line: Stick Plasma Grenade on a target to slow them, then turn on Hypercharge and hover with Air Assault to keep shooting from extra range. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, finish fleeing targets with Atomiser.
offlane.watchout: Against Steel, Grux or Greystone you are behind on paper, so farm near your tower and trade only when your jungler arrives.

carry.line: Stack Relentless with basic attacks and Hail of Arrows, then charge Piercing Shot through the lane. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, stand behind your team, use Heightened Senses to reposition, and channel Inner Fire into crowded fights.
carry.watchout: Murdock and Kira beat you in lane; against them, poke with Piercing Shot from range and stop trading basic attacks.

midlane.line: Open with Hail of Arrows to slow them, then use Heightened Senses for attack speed and keep basic attacking one target to build Relentless stacks. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, finish the stacked target with a charged Piercing Shot, then Inner Fire.
midlane.watchout: Into Lt. Belica or Gideon, one damage combo can kill you before your stacks matter; stay behind minions and save Heightened Senses to escape.

offlane.line: Poke with Piercing Shot, then slow them with Hail of Arrows and basic attack the same target to build Relentless stacks. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done near minute 16, start trades with Heightened Senses and finish fights with Inner Fire.
offlane.watchout: Most of these offlane matchups lean against you, so when Steel or Grux dives you, use Heightened Senses to escape, not to start the trade.

offlane.line: Bull Rush in to knock the target back, Shield Bash for the stun, and drop Force Shield to block their projectiles. Once Orion and Spectral Schematics are done, open team fights with Shield Slam onto as many enemies as you can.
offlane.watchout: Your lane matchups all read ours, so the danger is overstaying; when your shield breaks, back off and let Cybernetic Shell refresh.

support.line: Bull Rush to the enemy carry, Shield Bash for the stun, then wall off their shots with Force Shield to protect your carry. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall are done, start fights with Shield Slam and stand in front.
support.watchout: Dekker is the matchup marked theirs; hold Force Shield until they commit instead of rushing in first.

jungle.line: Gank with Bull Rush to knock the target toward your team, then Shield Bash to stun and Force Shield to block their escape shots. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, your abilities hit hard enough to follow Shield Slam on grouped enemies.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in the jungle; skip duels with them and play around your lanes.

offlane.line: Hit Highland Hurl to slow and shred armor, then Ruthless Assault up close to build Hersir stacks for an empowered Wild Rush. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, cast Unstoppable Force to dive towers and soak the fight.
offlane.watchout: Nearly every offlane matchup reads theirs; if they win trades, farm near your tower and wait for Unstoppable Force.

jungle.line: Charge Wild Rush from out of sight to gank, then Highland Hurl and Ruthless Assault to stack Hersir for an empowered root. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, cast Unstoppable Force to dive towers with your laners.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in lane; avoid duels with them and gank lanes instead.

support.line: Throw Highland Hurl first to slow them and cut their armor, then Wild Rush in and spin Ruthless Assault; at full Hersir stacks your next Highland Hurl roots. Once Stonewall and Forticus are built, stand in front and absorb hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane, so skip long Wild Rush charges into them and save Unstoppable Force to cleanse their stuns.

midlane.line: Throw Harvest Nettles to stack its damage, drop Untamed Growth on the target, then Bramble Patch to slow them inside it. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done, hold Fly Trap to pull several enemies together in a fight.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; if they push you in, farm with Harvest Nettles and wait for Fly Trap.

support.line: Drop Bramble Patch under the enemy, throw Harvest Nettles at the same target again and again, and land Untamed Growth while they are slowed. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall are done, stand in front of your carry and hold Fly Trap for grouped enemies.
support.watchout: Fly Trap pulls every nearby enemy into the plant and stuns them; cast it when your team is close enough to follow up, not alone.

offlane.line: Drop Bramble Patch to slow them, then throw Harvest Nettles, since repeat hits on one target deal more damage, and toss Untamed Growth where they will walk. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, use Fly Trap to pull grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: When an enemy jumps on you, drop Bramble Patch at your feet and walk back; you have no dash, so standing your ground loses.

carry.line: Throw Vortex Grenade to slow, fire Vaporize, then follow each cast with the Gunslinger triple shot. Once Sky Splitter and Viper are done, weave an ability between attacks in every fight and use Ventilate when targets are close.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, Murdock, Kira and Drongo beat you in lane; keep Rocket Dash ready to escape instead of trading in their range.

midlane.line: Open with Vaporize, follow with Vortex Grenade, and fire the triple-shot basic attack Gunslinger gives after each ability. Once Sky Splitter and Viper are done, weave basic attacks between abilities in longer trades and Rocket Dash out when they commit.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; stay back, farm with Vaporize, and wait for your jungler before trading.

offlane.line: Poke with Vortex Grenade and Vaporize, catch every Gunslinger triple-shot between them, and keep Rocket Dash ready since hits lower its cooldown. Once Sky Splitter and Viper are done, trade longer and use Ventilate when the target cannot escape.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora and Grux beat you in lane; stay at max range and dash away the moment they engage.

midlane.line: Bind the target with Arterial Grip, launch Bloodbound for attack speed, then fire Rupture and basic attack to trigger Hemophagia. Once Orion and Tainted Scepter are done, use Exsanguinate in longer fights to heal off heroes.
midlane.watchout: Getting stunned breaks your bind, so against Lt. Belica, Gideon, Gadget or Iggy & Scorch grip only after they use theirs.

offlane.line: Bind the target with Arterial Grip, launch Bloodbound for attack speed, then basic attack so Hemophagia keeps Lilith striking. Once Orion and Tainted Scepter are done, fire Rupture during the bind and hit heroes with Exsanguinate to heal back.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora, Grux and Bayle all beat you in lane; farm safely, since any stun breaks Arterial Grip.

support.line: Bind a target with Arterial Grip to slow them and steal attack speed, then cast Bloodbound and basic attack so Lilith keeps striking. Once Lifecore and Spirit Of Amir are done around minute 18, stay in fights longer and heal with Exsanguinate.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker, any stun or root on you breaks Arterial Grip, so bind only after they have used theirs.

carry.line: Throw Peekaboo! to slow and mark the target, then fire Knock, Knock! for the bonus damage and the cooldown cut. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, use Surprise, Surprise! to reposition and Back It Up! to drag a fleeing target back.
carry.watchout: TwinBlast, Sparrow, Murdock and Kira beat you in lane; poke from range with Knock, Knock! instead of trading up close.

midlane.line: Hit the target with Peekaboo!, then Knock, Knock! for the marked bonus damage and fast cooldown. After Deathstalker and Viper, place your Sonar Drone, wait in Surprise, Surprise! camouflage, and pick off whoever walks out alone.
midlane.watchout: Almost every mid matchup reads theirs; farm with Knock, Knock! from range and roam instead of dueling in lane.

support.line: Throw Peekaboo! to slow and mark a target, then hit them with Knock, Knock! for the bonus damage and the shorter cooldown. Once Stonewall and Forticus are done, you can stand in front and use Back It Up! to rewind an enemy who dove in.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Adele, Mourn and Narbash beat you in lane; place your Sonar Drone early and back off when they move in.

jungle.line: In Spirit stance, Windsurge in to slow, then Cyclebreaker for the stun while taking reduced damage. Swap to Body with 84000 Hairs for Pole Vault attack speed, and once The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation are done keep hitting to spawn clones.
jungle.watchout: Every jungle matchup reads theirs; avoid duels with the enemy jungler and gank lanes where your stun lands.

offlane.line: Leap in with Pole Vault for attack speed, slam with High Impact from height, and land five hits to spawn Clones. Once The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation are done, swap to Spirit stance for Cyclebreaker's damage reduction and stun when they fight back.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora, Grux and Bayle all beat you in lane; farm under tower and look to roam with Cloudwalker.

support.line: Open in Spirit stance with Cyclebreaker to take less damage, then throw the staff to stun the enemy in front of you; switch stance and use Force Push to shove attackers off your carry. Once Stonewall and Forticus land, stand in front and soak hits for your team.
support.watchout: Into Riktor, Dekker or Narbash they lock you down first; stay behind your carry and push only after their hook or stun is spent.

jungle.line: Lash Kick onto the target to slow them and stack Rising Storm, then keep basic attacking so every third hit triggers Windburn. Once Mutilator and The Perforator are done, use Windburn's range to fight from further back and Quelling Gale against ranged heroes.
jungle.watchout: Every jungle matchup reads theirs; skip early duels and gank lanes where Lash Kick can land first.

offlane.line: Pull in with Lash Kick to slow the target, turn on Windburn for range, and keep basic attacking to stack Rising Storm and heal. Once Mutilator and The Perforator are done, reflect their projectiles with Backlash and hold Quelling Gale against ranged burst.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora, Grux and Bayle all beat you in lane; take short Windburn trades and leave before they commit.

carry.line: Close in with Lash Kick to slow the target, then chain basic attacks so every third hit triggers Windburn's heal while Rising Storm builds speed. Once Mutilator and The Perforator land around minute 16, use Quelling Gale to block their shots while you chase.
carry.watchout: Against ranged lanes like Sparrow or Revenant, never Lash Kick in first; wait for their escape, then go, keeping Backlash to reflect shots.

jungle.line: Throw Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, rush through with Severance to reset it, and spin Anima Burst for healing. Once Alternator and Basilisk are done, channel Soulstorm in the middle of fights to pull everyone in and reset Severance.
jungle.watchout: Every jungle matchup reads theirs; skip early duels and gank lanes where Whispering Echoes can land first.

offlane.line: Throw Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, then Severance through the target to reset it and Anima Burst to heal back. Once Alternator and Basilisk are done, open with Soulstorm on grouped enemies for another Severance reset.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora and Grux beat you in lane; play safe and only trade when Severance can reset.

offlane.line: Hold Barricade to block a trade, swing it for the stun, then throw Spear of Nyr while they recover. Once Alternator and The Perforator are done, leap in with Coliseum on low targets, since Spear of Nyr hits them harder.
offlane.watchout: Steel beats you in lane here; against Steel, block with Barricade and wait out the stun instead of chasing.

jungle.line: Gank with Evade to close the gap, swing Barricade for the stun, and finish low targets with Spear of Nyr. Once Alternator and The Perforator are done, Coliseum a lone enemy you can kill inside it for permanent power.
jungle.watchout: Kwang is the one matchup marked theirs; avoid duels with Kwang and fight where your team can follow.

support.line: Raise Barricade to soak their poke, then swing the shield to stun and throw Spear of Nyr as your carry follows. Once Inquisition and Stonewall land near minute 18, leap on a low target with Coliseum and use Evade to stick or get out.
support.watchout: If Dekker stuns or walls you first, save Barricade to protect your carry instead of diving in alone.

support.line: Throw Ricochet to stun several enemies, drop Bad Medicine on them, and keep Infuse on your carry. Hit heroes to fill Triage Protocol for stronger Infuse, and once Lifecore and Lunaria are done, put Neural Regenesis on whoever gets dived.
support.watchout: Every support matchup reads theirs; stay behind your carry and save Ricochet for when they engage.

offlane.line: Land Ricochet to stun, drop Bad Medicine on the stunned target, and keep basic attacking to stack the burn and Triage Protocol. Once Combustion and Noxia are done, trade longer and save Neural Regenesis for yourself or an ally about to die.
offlane.watchout: Steel, Greystone, Scarlett, Aurora, Grux and Bayle all beat you in lane; farm from range and wait for your jungler.

midlane.line: Open with Bad Medicine to slow, bounce Ricochet through the group for the stun, and keep hitting to fill Triage Protocol. Once Combustion and Noxia are built, trade in short fights and keep Neural Regenesis ready for whoever gets focused.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid opponent wins this lane, so farm from range, Infuse to stay healthy, and wait for help before fighting Gideon or Renna.
